newsitem.title: USA: US Treasury's 3-, 6-mo bills seen at 4.91/5.06 pct.
newsitem.headline: US Treasury's 3-, 6-mo bills seen at 4.91/5.06 pct.

text.p: The U.S. Treasury's sale of $26.0 billion in three- and six-month bills is likely to produce average rates of 4.91 percent and 5.06 percent, respectively, traders said.
The sales should be easily absorbed, traders said.
The bidding deadline for the auction is 1300 EST/1800 GMT.
In when-issued trade at around 1240 EST/1740 GMT, three-month bill rates were quoted at 4.905 percent while the six-month rates were at 5.075 percent.
